newsitem.title: czech republic: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO RISE AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CONTINUES TO RISE AT FIXING.

text.p: Czech shares continued to rise at Wednesday's fixing but the pace of the upsurge slowed markedly and major issues were mixed.
SPT Telecom which raced ahead in the first two days of the week fell back 15 crowns to 3,275 while CEZ was unchanged on 990 and Komercni Banka rose 40 crowns to 2,100.
In the broader market, conference organiser BVV Brno, which is prone to volatility fell 122 crowns to 2,328.
